summary: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $750 million of common stock under Rule 415. The filing replaces a prior sales agreement and names 21 agents and forward purchasers. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices; last sale on July 23, 2026 was $32.10 per share. The issuer will not receive proceeds from forward sales until physical settlement. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation such as a tender or going-private transaction. No specified price, premium, or corporate event. The offering is standard ATM equity distribution, not a transformative event warranting reclassification.
